title: US Marine detained in Okinawa for robbery and murder of a woman
summary: A Marine from Futenma base was arrested as a suspect in the murder and robbery of a woman at a hotel in Naha, prompting a strong diplomatic protest from Japan to the US.

title: 9-year-old boy falls into sea in Awaji; man who attempted rescue dies
summary: An elementary school student fell into the sea while fishing on Awaji Island; an acquaintance who jumped in to save him drowned.

title: Japan excels at Asian Games with golds in wrestling, judo, and sepak takraw despite organizational issues
summary: The Japanese delegation won multiple gold medals in the final stretch of the Asian Games, while criticism persists over failures in the opening ceremony and flag management.

title: Dodgers start playoffs with victory and home runs from Ohtani and Murakami
summary: In the first game of the Division Series against the Braves, Shohei Ohtani recorded his first postseason hit and Munetaka Murakami hit a decisive home run.

title: Hanshin Tigers win first back-to-back Central League title with stellar performance from closer Kudo
summary: The Osaka team secured the consecutive title thanks to a dominant bullpen and the emergence of pitchers from independent leagues.

title: North Korea launches intermediate-range ballistic missile that flies 1,000 km according to Pyongyang
summary: The projectile, possibly a hypersonic weapon, fell into the Sea of Japan after a flight that Seoul and Tokyo estimate at 700 km, raising regional tensions.

title: Japanese tax agency detects 5.8 billion yen in undeclared income from Southern All Stars guitarist's company
summary: Authorities deemed improper an expense deduction scheme used by Kazuyoshi Sekiguchi's company, demanding payment of additional taxes.

title: Yokohama mayoral election: seven candidates compete after previous mayor's resignation over workplace harassment
summary: The official campaign kicks off with the participation of Pritzker Prize-winning architect Riken Yamamoto and six other candidates for the October 18 election.

title: Houthis attack Saudi Aramco refinery in Riyadh, causing major fire
summary: The Yemeni group claimed responsibility for the drone bombing of Saudi oil facilities, intensifying the escalation in the Red Sea.

title: Police search Toyama city hall over alleged manipulation of national census
summary: Authorities investigate whether the city artificially inflated its population in the 2020 census to receive larger fiscal transfers.
